d: Our Group Procurement & Logistics team delivers strategic sourcing and integrated supply chain solutions that strengthen operational resilience, optimise value and enable sustainable business performance.

The Manager Supply Chain Operations and Services will lead and manage end-to-end Supply Chain Operations and Group-wide functional governance and performance management of logistics services. They will ensure reliable, compliant and cost-effective distribution center operations, supply continuity, inventory and working-capital efficiency, service performance, compliance and cost effectiveness across planning, replenishment, warehousing, distribution, transportation and trade compliance. The role will drive an integrated operating model through standardised processes, digital enablement, performance governance and continuous improvement, while developing the people and capabilities required to support current and future business needs.
q: Hold an attested Bachelor's Degree or Masters degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Procurement,Operations Management, Engineering, Finance, Business Administration/MBA, or a related discipline.

10+ years of experience in an experience in supply chain, logistics, distribution, warehousing or another complex operational environment, including significant management responsibility in a multi-country or matrix organisation.
A recognised professional qualification in supply chain, logistics, procurement or operations management is preferred. Such as CIPS, CILT, CSCP or equivalent.

Experience should cover several of the following: demand and supply planning, inventory management, distribution centers, international transportation, freight markets, warehousing, customs and trade compliance, strategic third-party logistics providers, outsourced control-tower operations and large-scale transformation.
Aviation or another highly regulated and operationally critical environment is preferred.

Set performance expectations and oversee multidisciplinary teams covering planning, replenishment, inventory management, distribution centres, logistics, supplier performance and trade compliance to ensure effective operational execution.

Direct end-to-end supply chain execution of Uniform Distribution Centers, the General Distribution Center, warehousing, transportation and associated logistics services , ensuring consistent operating standards, capacity planning, resource deployment, operational readiness, service quality, inventory accuracy and effective fulfilment across all relevant locations and customer channels.

Optimize capacity, routing, consolidation, service levels and total logistics cost. Manage strategic logistics providers and outsourced service arrangements by establishing clear governance, service-level agreements, performance measures, reporting requirements and escalation protocols. Lead supply chain transformation and continuous improvement initiatives across warehouse operations, logistics network optimisation, regional distribution centres, systems implementation, process standardisation and new service solutions. The Regulatory Project Manager is responsible for overseeing core banking projects from inception to deployment.

The role is responsible for the full lifecycle of the project, using hybrid methodologies, and must ensure delivery is aligned with strategic business goals of the organisation. The role works closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact transformation projects The role combines strong technical understanding with exceptional project management skills and business acumen and requires deep domain and technical awareness to successfully navigate the system's complexity.. The Regulatory banking PM role is centered on managing the implementation, transformation, or upgrade of the bank's central IT systems, which are critical to all operations.
As the Regulatory Project Manager, your responsibilities will include;

Developing and managing comprehensive project plans, defining scope, objectives, deliverables, and milestones. This includes setting deadlines, managing the budget, and ensuring effective resource allocation.

Proactively identifying potential risks and issues (RAID - Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) specific to the banking domain (e.g., data loss, security breaches, compliance failure) and prepare detailed mitigation strategies.
Managing communication and expectations across a diverse, complex stakeholder group, including:
IT Teams, Architects, and Technical Leads
Monitoring and reporting project status, risks, and performance metrics to management. Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for auditability and governance.

Regulatory Compliance: ensuring the project design and implementation (including data integrity, security, and process flows) adhere strictly to local and international financial regulations (e.g., AML, KYC, FATCA, Basel III).
Coordinating the complex process of data migration, ensuring data integrity and zero information loss during the transition.
Establish clear migration pathways and contingency plans to prevent service disruptions.
Manage the interfaces and system integration with surrounding applications (e.g., wealth management, loan systems, digital channels).
Manage the relationship and contracts with the Core Banking System vendor, tracking their tasks, deliverables, and commitment to the project's success.

An understanding of the banking IT world, system design, databases (SQL), and API management (REST, SOAP) to effectively liaise with technical leads and investigate system logs or queries when necessary.
